_about: Single source of truth for progress on docs/improvement-plan-2026-11.md. Edit a status here, then run `python scripts/improvement_status.py`. Statuses: done | partial | open | decision | owner | other-repo.

p0.name: improve/phase0-console-engine-hardening
p0.summary: Console + engine hardening: secrets out of the browser, session/login, fail-closed auth incl. /mcp, WP renderer XSS, decay-job and Discord-notice fixes, redirect/save bugs

p1.name: improve/phase1-quality-gates
p1.summary: Quality gate enforced at approval, strict fact-check, AEO lint, real Article structured data, honest dateModified, cadence cap, cannibalization v2, REFRESH_POLICY switch

p2.name: improve/phase2-site-api-keys
p2.summary: Per-site API keys with scopes + fail-closed route authorization and the cross-tenant test matrix

p3.name: improve/phase3-tenant-isolation
p3.summary: No silent cross-tenant widening, site-filtered logs, per-site monthly spend cap

p4.name: improve/phase4-remaining-hardening
p4.summary: SSRF guard, log redaction, Discord access control, restricted sheet tool, client retry rules, adapter fixes, /ready, upgraded dependencies, this status board

p5.name: improve/phase5-pipeline-adapters
p5.summary: /run_workflow repaired, WP inline renderer rewritten (linked images, code spans, nested lists), keyword/overall-score gates made honest, link validator soft-404 + bot-blocked handling, per-site IndexNow keys, bounded idempotency cache, flash-message codes, keyword/score gates, Sanity revision guard, per-request SSRF guard in the screenshot browser, import without provider keys, no phantom sites from typos

SEC-04.note: console strips secrets AND the engine redacts list_sites/MCP

SEC-05.note: safe_get on every image/link/title/WP fetch; residual DNS-rebinding race documented in lib/safe_fetch.py

SEC-06.note: WP renderer (scheme allow-list, JSON-LD escaping) and the SDK React HTML fallback

SEC-11.note: Sanity prints/headers, IndexNow/Bing keys, tool-result logging, DB-URL credentials

SEC-13.note: custom-site pushes are HMAC-signed with timestamp and delivery id, retried, per-site URL/secret; revalidate webhook compares in constant time, drops the body/query secret by default and uses after() for IndexNow

SEC-14.note: site secrets (WordPress app password, IndexNow/Bing keys, Discord webhook, delivery secret) are Fernet-encrypted in the database with SECRETS_KEY (rotation supported) and decrypted only where used; scripts/encrypt_site_secrets.py converts existing rows; the console encrypts instances.json API keys with INSTANCES_KEY. Both are off until you set a key - you must generate and store them.

SEC-15.note: security headers, media proxy, /docs gated, shared-mode CORS default-deny, and a per-request-nonce CSP (every script on /login verified to carry the nonce against a real production server). The nonce policy ships in report-only mode (CSP_MODE); switching to enforce is your call after you click through the console in a browser.

SEC-16.note: confirm/rotate the Google service-account key in GCP IAM (same action as SEC-22)

SEC-17.note: restricted sheet tool for the generator, evaluator and brief agents

SEC-18.note: allow-list defaults to the Discord application owner; set ALLOWED_DISCORD_USER_IDS to add others

SEC-20.note: model-chosen URLs must be plain (no query/fragment) unless the host came from this run's search results; title fetches capped; untrusted-text agents still hold the tools, so data can ride in a short path segment

SEC-21.note: get_brain_notes_tool returns first-hand voice notes in full but only the titles/tags of LLM-drafted coverage records, as data under a different key

SEC-22.note: rotate/delete the key in GCP IAM; delete local branches Extending-AgentRunner and backup-bb314a6; git reflog expire + gc

SEC-23.note: least-privilege workflow permissions; git credentials are persisted only for log_coverage; secrets in a master-only GitHub Environment is a repo setting you must apply

SEC-24.note: engine lock upgraded earlier; discord_bot requirements now bounded to tested majors

ENG-03.note: publish single-flight now spans processes (database lease)

ENG-04.note: single-flight done; LAST_USAGE module global and cost-in-finally still open

ENG-05.note: race and no-op env mutation removed, REST+MCP share one lock; handlers are not site-scoped yet (needs TenantContext)

ENG-09.note: /logs is site-filtered; stage history/stage rows still have no site_id (platform-only)

ENG-10.note: approve no longer regresses a published article; the event is article.approved (legacy_event for one release); an empty article cannot be published (PUBLISH_REQUIRE_CONTENT) and approving one warns (QUALITY_GATE_REQUIRE_CONTENT=1 makes it a hard stop)

ENG-12.note: atomic Tavily meter, concurrent site creation safe; unique (site_id, keyword_id) on articles and a unique finalize row need a migration, so they wait for Alembic (OPS-01)

ENG-13.note: REST/MCP submit refuses unknown sites unless SDK_AUTO_CREATE_SITES=1 or it is the default site; new slugs are validated; read paths in lib/store.py still auto-create

ENG-14.note: Idempotency-Key responses are stored in the database for 24h and replayed by any worker

ENG-15.note: create_all once per engine; SQLite busy timeout (WAL opt-in); Alembic baseline added (existing databases: alembic stamp 0001); a UTC TypeDecorator for timestamps is still open

ENG-16.note: classified statuses + machine-readable code and next on REST errors; both clients expose them

ENG-18.note: article_stats defers the body and counts words in SQL (approximate: runs of spaces over-count slightly); the exact count stays on the per-article endpoints

ENG-20.note: a WordPress draft push does not stamp published_at and does not ping search engines; 'live' is reported on the publish result; going live later stamps it

ENG-21.note: X-Request-ID on every response and log line, LOG_FORMAT=json, access log without query strings; /ready added earlier

ENG-22.note: split sdk/service.py (3.4k lines) along the seams in the plan

PIPE-01.note: tool renamed + contract test; the SDK path enforces the gate in code, the Sheets run_content path is still prompt-driven

PIPE-02.note: a nested agent (the evaluator via as_tool) now runs through run_with_fallback, with model fallback and usage accounting; the driven agent is recognised by identity so it cannot recurse

PIPE-03.note: the writer prompt no longer lets a high Jev score replace the evaluator (at least one evaluation per draft); QUALITY_GATE_REQUIRE_EVAL=1 makes recorded evaluator sub-scores mandatory for engine-generated articles at approval

PIPE-06.note: scheduled runs (run_stage) and the API lifespan share one helper that injects the site's Brand DNA; agents are still module-level objects rather than built per run from a TenantContext (TEN-02)

PIPE-07.note: internal-link fetch budget is per time window (INTERNAL_LINKS_WINDOW_S) and defaults to 6 calls (one per H2), so a long-lived API/MCP process no longer returns [] forever

PIPE-10.note: arrays-have-items contract test; Optional/union params and retries/delay on the full sheet tool remain

PIPE-13.note: one FallbackAgentRunner per process (one set of quota books); making the router the sole quota owner is still open

PIPE-14.note: per-run budget (RUN_MAX_MODEL_CALLS, RUN_MAX_SECONDS, reset per stage) plus clamped crawl/extract arguments

PIPE-16.note: pipeline concurrency is per stage, so queued runs of different stages no longer evict each other

PIPE-18.note: LanguageTool is one process singleton (or a remote server); the pipeline caches its download

PIPE-19.note: runner fleet drops every model router.yaml disables

PIPE-20.note: preferred/banned term contradiction fixed and guarded by a test; the author persona is still hard-coded rather than read from BrandProfile

PIPE-21.note: the image-provider quota breaker is stored in the database as an expiring flag, so a new CI run starts with it engaged instead of re-burning an attempt

PIPE-22.note: PR CI (pytest, console tsc+tests, SDK build+smoke); unused deps removed; bs4 -> beautifulsoup4; requirements.txt exported from the lock; bot requirements bounded

PIPE-23.note: log_coverage retries a rejected push after a rebase, and LOG_COVERAGE_GIT=0 keeps coverage in the database only

ADP-01.note: Sanity publish compares a content hash and engine article id: unchanged = reported no-op, changed = revision-guarded patch, other article/Studio post on the slug = explicit conflict; SANITY_PUBLISH_AS_DRAFT option

ADP-02.note: inline renderer fixed (linked images, code spans, nested lists, balanced-paren URLs); a full markdown AST (markdown-it-py) is still the cleaner end state

ADP-04.note: signed, retried, per-site delivery wired into publish; a persistent outbox (survives a crash mid-retry) is still open

ADP-05.note: relative links, quotes, html blocks, tables in fences, ==/~~ in code, links in table cells fixed; horizontal rules stay literal (the Studio schema has no divider type) and list-image ordering is open

ADP-07.note: payload v2: meta_title, canonical, featured image, OG block; SDK buildMetadata() for Next.js

ADP-08.note: SEO meta is probed against the site's registered REST meta (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, AIOSEO) and only storable keys are sent; the result reports the active plugin or a clear warning; JSON-LD is wrapped in a core/html block

ADP-09.note: refresh rewrites _elementor_data for pages built with the Elementor target

ADP-12.note: Content-Disposition, sniffed MIME, checked alt-text write; dedupe of media on retry still open

ADP-13.note: also fixed a hidden second bug (unterminated regex) that stopped the module importing

ADP-14.note: publishedAt/updatedAt/canonicalUrl fields in schema and adapter; SANITY_REQUIRE_IMAGE=1 holds an image-less post as a draft instead of publishing it invalid

SEO-02.note: SDK/approve path; the Sheets path still relies on the prompt

SEO-04.note: REFRESH_POLICY switch is built (escalate|in_place); you choose — recommended in_place

SEO-05.note: cadence cap + same-site near-duplicate check at approval (word-shingle similarity, blocks above 50%); cross-tenant duplicate detection is deliberately not done (another tenant's content is not ours to read)

SEO-06.note: PAA atomization is OFF unless PAA_ATOMIZATION=on, needs a stated unique_data, and is capped per site (PAA_MAX_PAGES/30 days); the gray-policy reference text in the seo-pack skill is not edited

SEO-09.note: overall is capped at mean(sub-scores)+EVAL_OVERALL_TOLERANCE; verifying code snippets against current docs is still open

SEO-10.note: requires real brain/ voice notes first; you must write entries before a gate can demand them

SEO-13.note: exact-path inbound counts, an explicit find_orphans(), and the internal-link minimum scales to the posts that exist; depth/role checks are still not wired into the flow

SEO-15.note: difficulty normalized to 0-100 across providers; a SERP endpoint and a real intent classifier are still open

SEO-16.note: minimum-prior-clicks floor, year-over-year seasonality (DECAY_USE_YOY=1) and a rank/demand/CTR cause diagnosis are in; GSC pagination and URL-variant (slash/www) matching are still open

SEO-17.note: the SERP baseline lives in its own row, written once and moved only deliberately (after a reported drift), so cache expiry cannot shift it; threshold wording fixed earlier; SERP-feature tracking needs a provider that returns features

SEO-18.note: share-of-voice: multiple samples, competitors, confidence, scheduling

SEO-20.note: FAQ minimum is per-brief (faq_required/faq_min) and per-instance (FAQ_MIN, 0 = optional); the writer is told not to pad; FAQPage schema is emitted only when FAQs exist

SEO-22.note: derived tags capped (DERIVED_TAGS_MAX, default 3); a minimum article count before a new term is created and noindex on thin archives are still open

SEO-23.note: stock photos narrower than 1200px are skipped (the caller falls back to an AI image) and big ones use a 1600px rendition; alt text describes the picture; width/height on WordPress is not added because it would invalidate Gutenberg block markup

SEO-24.note: scripts/audit_articles.py re-runs every existing article through today's gate, read-only, and lists what would be refused and why (run it, then decide what to rewrite)

SEO-25.note: llms.txt entries carry a one-line description; llms-full.txt (index + full markdown, size-capped) via ?full=true

SEO-26.note: how-to/tutorial queries get a 1500-word floor (TUTORIAL_WORD_FLOOR); compact transactional pages keep theirs

FE-01.note: live site repo: move the Disallow rules under User-agent: * (keep /_next/ crawlable)

FE-02.note: sdk/sanity/lib/seo.ts fallbacks fixed; headline/breadcrumb-name fallbacks live in the site's own template

FE-04.note: engine should call the revalidate webhook after publish; site ISR

FE-05.note: real 404 for .md URLs; /raw must keep link and image URLs

FE-06.note: remove the 'VERIFIED ACCURACY' badge or back it with the gate result

FE-07.note: cap the title when a brand suffix is appended

CON-05.note: cadence, budget AND the Content group (min words, FAQ on/off, brand voice prompt) are now read by the engine; the Image group (preference, relevancy threshold, VLM model, revisions), Indexing and Notifications groups are still saved but not consumed

CON-10.note: ids, modes, slugs and settings numbers validated; free-text length limits are enforced by the engine (typed meta patch) rather than duplicated in each action

CON-12.note: split articles/[id]/page.tsx, site-cadence-settings.tsx and lib/shell.tsx (needs browser verification)

CON-13.note: decide whether you need separate logins/roles (owner/reviewer/client) before building accounts and an actor on mutations

CON-14.note: site-select is now a keyboard-operable listbox (roles, arrow keys, focus return); toasts already announce; the rest of the console has not been audited with a screen reader and this is not browser-verified

CON-15.note: tests for session, redirect-safety, secrets, instance guard, limiter; server-action tests open

CON-16.note: flash messages are HMAC-signed by the server action's redirect and verified in middleware; a crafted or stale link shows nothing. (An earlier version of this fix accepted only fixed codes and would have silenced every real toast; caught and replaced before release.)

TEN-02.note: replace import-time site identity/provider globals with TenantContext lookups

TEN-03.note: per-site monthly USD cap and a per-site Tavily budget

TEN-04.note: DB job queue + scheduler honouring cadence; retire the single-site Actions cron

TEN-05.note: user allow-list done; one bot serving many sites (guild -> site routing) still open

TEN-06.note: post-id WordPress/Elementor operations (REST and MCP) take site_slug and use that site's credentials; mandatory on a multi-site engine, never the process env WordPress

TEN-07.note: SERP baseline / SEO cache is namespaced per site (the drift job compares only its own site's rows); staged images live in a per-database folder; the Sheets keyword claim is per process by design

TEN-08.note: POST /sdk/v1/provision (platform key): site + scoped one-time key + health check + a list of what a human still has to do; idempotent; python client provision_site()

TEN-09.note: decide: pooled paid provider keys with per-tenant caps vs a free-tier account per site

OPS-01.note: audit rows record the acting key; Sentry (scrubbed, optional extra); scripts/backup_db.py with retention; sdk/ops.py + scripts/alerts_check.py (budget, cadence, readiness) posting to Discord; uptime probe workflow; Alembic baseline; docs/operations-runbook.md. Turning on Sentry, the uptime secrets, scheduling the backup/alerts, and Neon PITR are settings only you can make.

OPS-02.note: stage runs, publish and generate are single-flight across worker processes via expiring database leases; Idempotency-Key replay is stored in the database

0.title: Stop the bleed
0.goal: Close the open doors: unauthenticated /mcp and REST, secrets in responses and the browser, XSS in rendered output, broken console saves, the decay-job false alarms.
0.exit: /mcp and REST reject unauthenticated calls in every environment; no API response or console prop contains a secret; WP output passes the XSS fixtures; console saves show success; the decay job has a failure-injection test.

1.title: Make the quality gates real
1.goal: Move quality from prompts into code: the fact-check, eval, link and AEO gates run on every path to approved; honest structured data and dates; cadence and duplicate controls.
1.exit: No article can reach approved without a passing gate and a stored audit row; the wrong-code regression fixture fails the gate; cannibalization clusters merged.

2.title: Tenant context, auth and secrets
2.goal: Make shared mode safe: per-site scoped keys, no process-global tenant state, secrets out of plaintext, readiness and error contracts, observable requests.
2.exit: Key A gets 403/404 for every site-B resource on every REST and MCP route; shared mode runs two test tenants with different WordPress targets and zero env fallbacks; no secret in any response, log or client bundle.

3.title: Scheduler, workers, quotas, adapters
3.goal: Replace the single-site Actions pipeline with a job queue honouring per-site cadence; one quota owner; a real adapter contract with signed deliveries; retire the Sheets state store.
3.exit: Three sites with different cadences run on one shared engine for a week with no manual triggers; a new destination is added purely through the adapter protocol and passes the contract suite.

4.title: Fleet console and operations
4.goal: Operate many instances: fleet home, approvals inbox, users and roles, provisioning API, error tracking, backups, alerting, SEO monitoring upgrades.
4.exit: One screen shows every instance's health, queue and spend; a new client site is provisioned with one call; an outage or a spend overrun alerts without anyone looking.

F.title: Live website frontend (separate repository)
F.goal: Fixes that belong to the site's own Next.js app, not this engine. Tracked here so they are not lost.
F.exit: The listed fixes are applied in the website repository.
